Deep past: schools, faith, losses, earlier residences and earlier jobs are absent unless the canonical opening generator establishes them; no event inferred from a trait.
Household consumption contracts, hiring, employer revenue, demography, elections, and law effects are not implemented; their totals cannot establish realism.
Labor context: no school enrollment, primary care responsibility, pensions, business books or funded public staffing imported; canonical matcher reads the records actually present.
Money: CES nonhousing categories and a hypothetical HUD shelter budget exclude actual tenure, debts, taxes, insurance contracts and medical service bills; no housing contract is invented.

Opening peer prior is expanded only for requested people and their generated peer groups; other cohorts remain unexpanded. Reciprocal historical acquaintance and name recognition are generated assumptions. Historical school attendance/existence, current closeness, and continued contact are not verified; no independent network calibration has been completed.
Opening vintage: 2021-01-01 household/population estimates retain later source vintages; no reconstructed 2021 census or migration history.
Prototype selects one discretionary scored act per tier activation; a complete daily activity plan is not yet modeled.
The opening generator records no known coworkers for the selected player; actual coworkers are in the daily circle, but acquaintance knowledge is not invented.

priorBaseline.comparisonScope: Same year harness and seed, with changed circle/input/source. Rates are measured; the rate difference does not establish that adding acquaintances causes a speed improvement.

proofLimits: Generated school-peer roster size and persistent name recognition are uncalibrated priors, not verified historical or current relationships.
Act-stat hashes match within these four cores; this is not whole-state parity with the earlier three-person input.
The 64 opening jobs and missing consumption, demography and laws do not establish realistic totals.
Process peak includes population building, warmup, prior runs and serialization; isolated steady-state memory is not measured here.
This run does not establish an ordinary event-born civic drive, full-county pre-run or P9 life replay.
